map.错题本自动归类与重练提醒 使用指南: Mistake Notebook Auto-Classification and Repractice Reminder User Guide
map.添加错题后自动按学科和错误类型归类，基于间隔重复算法(1/3/7/14天)安排复: After a mistake is added it is classified automatically by subject and error type, and spaced repetition (1/3/7/14 days) schedules the review with an automatic reminder when it is due.
map.自动归类：按学科与错因分组。: Automatic classification: grouped by subject and error cause.
map.间隔排期：到期智能提醒。: Interval scheduling: smart reminders when due.
map.重练：到期推送复习。: Repractice: a review is pushed when it is due.
map.：示例：数学计算错归「计算」组，安排第 1/3/7 天复习。: Example: a wrong maths calculation goes into the "calculation" group, with reviews scheduled on days 1, 3 and 7.
map.字数统计 / 字符统计 / 行数统计: Word count / character count / line count
map.间隔重复强化薄弱点，降低遗忘。: Spaced repetition strengthens the weak points and reduces forgetting.
map.到期在本地提醒，需打开页面查看。: Due dates are reminded locally, so you need to open the page to see them.
map.存浏览器本地，不上传。: Stored in the local browser, not uploaded.
